title: Inverse image of a representable etale sheaf
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For an object $V$ of $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] the fibre product $X\times_YV$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with its first projection is an object of $X_{\Et}$. Let $f_*:\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\Et})\to\mathrm{Sh}(Y_{\Et})$ be the direct image of sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], $(f_*\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(X\times_YV)$, and let $f^{-1}:\mathrm{Sh}(Y_{\Et})\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\Et})$ be a left adjoint of $f_*$. For a $Y$-scheme $W$ write $h_W$ for the sheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}_Y(U,W)$ on $Y_{\Et}$, and for an $X$-scheme $W'$ write $h_{W'}$ for the sheaf $U\mapsto\operatorname{Mor}_X(U,W')$ on $X_{\Et}$ (these presheaves are sheaves by [lem-weil-pbc-small-etale-representable-presheaf-sheaf]). Then for every object $V$ of $Y_{\Et}$ there is an isomorphism of sheaves $f^{-1}h_V\cong h_{X\times_YV}$ on $X_{\Et}$, natural in $V$ (for $Y$-morphisms $V\to V'$ in $Y_{\Et}$).
